product.title: Sara Lee Artesano Original Bread, 20 oz, Soft White Pre-sliced White Bread, Bag (Pack of 7)
product.description: Bring the distinguished taste of an artisan bakery home to your family with Sara Lee Artesano Original Artisan Bread. With its rich flavor and distinctly creamy character, all the flavors you love come together with this artisan white bread. Baked with the goodness you’d expect from one of America’s most trusted names in bread, Sara Lee Artesano bakery artisan bread elevates everything you create with it. This artisan-style sandwich bread is made without any artificial colors, flavors, or preservatives and, like all Sara Lee sliced bread, it is made with no high fructose corn syrup, so you can trust that you’re sharing only the best grains with your family. From hearty avocado toast to mouthwatering paninis and scrumptious grilled cheese sandwiches, you can count on Sara Lee artisan bread to provide superior taste and quality. Enjoy Sara Lee Artesano sandwich bread right out of the bag for convenient meals to fit your busy schedule or place in the freezer for later. Make the routine remarkable with Sara Lee Artesano Original Bakery bread. This item is Shelf Stable. Size Description: Regular.
